physical_mapping.omega_cdm: CLASS omega_cdm = CAMB omch2; zero=0, baseline=0.1201075
physical_mapping.YHe_reason: CLASS sBBN_2025 natural-spline mapping; direct CLASS verbose output rounds to 0.2452. Do not use CAMB default PRIMAT value for this comparison.
physical_mapping.dark_energy: flat closure with w=-1, wa=0, cs2=1, fluid model; no fld/scf component in CLASS
physical_mapping.recombination: Explicit hyrec in CAMB; CLASS uses HyRec 2020. Residual implementation differences remain a systematic.

output_mapping.tt: CAMB lensed_scalar[:,0] with CMB_unit=None and raw_cl=False equals ell(ell+1)C_l^TT/(2pi), matching CLASS class_format TT.
output_mapping.phiphi: CAMB PP is [ell(ell+1)]^2 C_l^phiphi/(2pi); divide by ell(ell+1) to match CLASS class_format phiphi=ell(ell+1)C_l^phiphi/(2pi).
output_mapping.pk: z=0, nonlinear=False, hubble_units=True, k_hunit=True; k in h/Mpc and P(k) in (Mpc/h)^3.
output_mapping.growth: CAMB f_sigma8/sigma8 is a diagnostic; CLASS growth_f has its own definition. Do not silently equate them.

gauge_boundary.camb: built-in cdm_gauge/synchronous density variables; no exposed gauge selector in CAMBparams 2.0.5
gauge_boundary.consequence: CMB observables are physical; matter-density spectra are not naively gauge identical at k=0.001. Treat k>=0.01 as primary and k=0.001 as secondary diagnostic.

high_accuracy_trigger: Run high only after inspecting fiducial outputs; discrepancies above 5% trigger mapping and accuracy review, not an automatic physical verdict.

metrics.ratio: zero/baseline within each code, then CAMB ratio divided by CLASS integral ratio minus one
metrics.threshold_meaning: cross-code diagnostic only; not numerical convergence proof, observational uncertainty, or model exclusion

boundaries: No tiny CDM component is introduced.
No observational likelihood, parameter search, joint BBN, or nonlinear calculation.
Different recombination and perturbation implementations remain possible systematics.
If CAMB fails for zero CDM, record the exception and do not replace zero with a nonzero approximation.
